request: Split the invite work across two agents in parallel: the API with Codex and the page with Claude, then QA it.
success: team and task ids with each task's stage; what was integrated per task with verification evidence; QA verdict
notes: Positive case: plan with dependencies and areas, start workers, verify each result independently, integrate one task at a time, finish with QA. Nothing reaches the person's checkout except via tasks integrate.

request: The lead agent for the invites team stopped. Take over and tell me where things stand.
success: where each task stands from team show; what is waiting in the inbox; what was found before starting more workers
notes: Boundary case: recover a team without starting another lead. A new lead takes over with team show and msg inbox; team create would strand the existing work on a second team.

request: The API worker and the page worker disagree on the invite payload shape. Sort it out between them.
success: the payload shape settled between the workers; which worker messages were exchanged; lead verification of the outcome
notes: Failure-recovery case: two agents acting on the same team. Shared details are settled worker-to-worker through the mailbox (msg send to the task id), not by creating another team.

request: Integrate the invite API task; if it doesn't apply cleanly, get it fixed without losing anything.
success: which tasks integrated and their files; the conflict named with the files involved; the reopen feedback for the fix
notes: Failure-recovery case: an integration conflict. A task that does not apply cleanly stops with nothing of that task changed; the lead reopens it to be brought up to date instead of forcing it in.
